description:
Kotlin error reporting client for a private, self-hosted ForgeOps tracker instance. A
    from-scratch port of sdks/java (this repo's own JVM client), rewritten idiomatically rather
    than wrapped -- see README.md for exactly what that means and why this exists alongside the
    Java client rather than folding into it, the same "distinct enough to earn its own SDK"
    reasoning behind TypeScript existing alongside Node.js elsewhere in this repo.
